name: Datadog
summary: Send run, partition and approval metrics and events from Ogun to Datadog, on any Datadog site. Ogun never needs your Datadog keys in a workflow.

fields.name: api_key
fields.label: API key
fields.help: Read from the environment of the exporter process, not from Ogun's secret store.

notes: Metrics: ogun.workflows, ogun.runs.active, ogun.approvals.pending, ogun.streams, ogun.node_instances (tagged by state). Events: failed runs and approvals waiting for a person.

implementation.evidence: Sink in ogun-export, written from public documentation and checked against a local fake in unit tests; not run against the real service.
